create_ConfigSearchPathImpl: create a ConfigSearchPathImpl instance to manage a list of search path elements for Hydra config lookup
append_search_path_element: append a new search path element with provider and path to the config search path list
prepend_search_path_element: prepend a new search path element with provider and path to the front of the config search path
find_match_in_search_path: find the index of a matching search path element by provider or path using SearchPathQuery
get_config_search_path: get the mutable list of SearchPathElement objects from the ConfigSearchPathImpl instance
